title.en: Reading: A father's advice to his daughter
title.ur: Parhna: Baap ki apni beti ko naseehat

intro.en: A father gives his daughter Hind advice on the eve of her wedding. He tells her that marriage is a long partnership with big responsibilities, not a short trip. Read each paragraph slowly. Notice the word إِنَّ (inna – 'indeed'), which makes a sentence stronger.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek baap shaadi se pehle ki raat apni beti Hind ko naseehat karta hai. Woh kehta hai ke shaadi ek lambi shirakat hai jis mein bari zimmedariyan hain, chhota safar nahin. Har hissa aahista parhein. Lafz إِنَّ (inna – 'beshak') par dhyan dein, yeh baat ko mazboot banata hai.
intro.ar: أَبٌ يُوصي ابْنَتَهُ هِنْداً قَبْلَ زَفافِها، وَيُخْبِرُها أَنَّ الزَّواجَ شَراكَةٌ طَويلَةٌ وَمَسْؤولِيَّةٌ كَبيرَةٌ وَلَيْسَ رِحْلَةً قَصيرَةً. نَقْرَأُ كُلَّ فِقْرَةٍ بِبُطْءٍ، وَنَنْتَبِهُ لِكَلِمَةِ «إِنَّ» الَّتي تُقَوّي الجُمْلَةَ.

dialogue.ar: قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الزِّفافِ بِلَيْلَةٍ، جَلَسَ أَبو هِنْدٍ مَعَ ابْنَتِهِ وَقالَ لَها بِصَوْتٍ هادِئٍ:
dialogue.tr: qabla yawmi z-zifāfi bi-laylatin, jalasa abū hindin maʿa ibnatihi wa-qāla lahā bi-ṣawtin hādiʾ
dialogue.en: The night before the wedding day, Hind's father sat with his daughter and said to her in a quiet voice:
dialogue.ur: Shaadi ke din se ek raat pehle Hind ke abbu apni beti ke paas baithe aur narm aawaz mein kaha:

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الزَّواجَ يا بُنَيَّتي شَراكَةٌ طَويلَةٌ، وَلَيْسَ رِحْلَةً قَصيرَةً.
dialogue.tr: inna z-zawāja yā bunayyatī sharākatun ṭawīla, wa-laysa riḥlatan qaṣīra
dialogue.en: Marriage, my little daughter, is a long partnership, not a short trip.
dialogue.ur: Shaadi, meri bitiya, ek lambi shirakat hai, koi chhota safar nahin.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنَّ كُلاًّ مِنَ الشَّريكَيْنِ مَسْؤولٌ عَنْ سَعادَةِ الآخَرِ وَعَنْ أُسْرَتِهِما.
dialogue.tr: wa-inna kullan mina sh-sharīkayni masʾūlun ʿan saʿādati l-ākhari wa-ʿan usratihimā
dialogue.en: Each of the two partners is responsible for the other's happiness and for their family.
dialogue.ur: Dono sharik ek doosre ki khushi aur apne khandan ke zimmedar hain.

dialogue.ar: سَتَبْدَئينَ بِاحْتِرامِ زَوْجِكِ وَفَهْمِ طِباعِهِ، ثُمَّ تَكْبُرُ الأُسْرَةُ وَيَأْتي الأَطْفالُ.
dialogue.tr: satabdaʾīna bi-ḥtirāmi zawjiki wa-fahmi ṭibāʿih, thumma takburu l-usratu wa-yaʾtī l-aṭfāl
dialogue.en: You will begin by respecting your husband and understanding his nature, then the family grows and children come.
dialogue.ur: Aap shauhar ka ehteram aur uske mizaaj ko samajhne se shuru karengi, phir khandan barhega aur bachche aayenge.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنَّ الأُمَّ الَّتي تُحْسِنُ تَرْبِيَةَ أَبْنائِها تَبْني جيلاً صالِحاً لِلأُمَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-inna l-umma llatī tuḥsinu tarbiyata abnāʾihā tabnī jīlan ṣāliḥan li-l-umma
dialogue.en: A mother who raises her children well builds a good generation for the nation.
dialogue.ur: Jo maan apne bachon ki achhi tarbiyat karti hai woh qaum ke liye ek nek nasl banati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلبَيْتِ دَوْراً كَبيراً في تَكْوينِ هُوِيَّةِ الطِّفْلِ وَأَخْلاقِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-inna li-l-bayti dawran kabīran fī takwīni huwiyyati ṭ-ṭifli wa-akhlāqih
dialogue.en: The home has a big role in forming a child's identity and character.
dialogue.ur: Ghar ka bachche ki pehchan aur akhlaq banane mein bada kirdar hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلا تَظُنّي يا هِنْدُ أَنَّ بَيْتَ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ مَكانٌ بِلا مَسْؤولِيّاتٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa-lā taẓunnī yā hindu anna bayta z-zawjiyyati makānun bi-lā masʾūliyyāt
dialogue.en: And do not think, Hind, that the marital home is a place without responsibilities.
dialogue.ur: Aur Hind, yeh mat samajhna ke shaadi ka ghar aisi jagah hai jahan koi zimmedari nahin.

dialogue.ar: فَبَعْضُ الفَتَياتِ يَتَخَيَّلْنَ أَنَّ الحَياةَ بَعْدَ الزَّواجِ لَهْوٌ وَتَسْلِيَةٌ، وَهذا ظَنٌّ خاطِئٌ.
dialogue.tr: fa-baʿḍu l-fatayāti yatakhayyalna anna l-ḥayāta baʿda z-zawāji lahwun wa-tasliya, wa-hādhā ẓannun khāṭiʾ
dialogue.en: Some girls imagine that life after marriage is fun and entertainment, and this is a wrong idea.
dialogue.ur: Kuch ladkiyan sochti hain ke shaadi ke baad zindagi khel tamasha hai, aur yeh ghalat khayal hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الحُرِّيَّةَ بِلا حُدودٍ تَقودُ إِلى الفَوْضى وَالدَّمارِ.
dialogue.tr: inna l-ḥurriyyata bi-lā ḥudūdin taqūdu ilā l-fawḍā wa-d-damār
dialogue.en: Freedom without limits leads to chaos and destruction.
dialogue.ur: Hudood ke baghair azaadi afra-tafri aur tabahi tak le jati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنَّ البَيْتَ يَحْتاجُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ إِلى تَخْطيطٍ وَعَمَلٍ، لا إِلى كَسَلٍ وَنَوْمٍ طَويلٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa-inna l-bayta yaḥtāju kulla yawmin ilā takhṭīṭin wa-ʿamal, lā ilā kasalin wa-nawmin ṭawīl
dialogue.en: The home needs planning and work every day, not laziness and long sleep.
dialogue.ur: Ghar ko har roz mansooba-bandi aur mehnat chahiye, susti aur lambi neend nahin.

dialogue.ar: وَالزَّوْجَةُ النّاجِحَةُ تُنَظِّمُ وَقْتَها، وَتَتَعاوَنُ مَعَ زَوْجِها في أَعْمالِ البَيْتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-z-zawjatu n-nājiḥatu tunaẓẓimu waqtahā, wa-tataʿāwanu maʿa zawjihā fī aʿmāli l-bayt
dialogue.en: The successful wife organizes her time and cooperates with her husband in the housework.
dialogue.ur: Kamyab biwi apna waqt tarteeb se rakhti hai aur ghar ke kamon mein shauhar ke saath taawun karti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا عادَ زَوْجُكِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ مُتْعَباً، فَاسْتَقْبِليهِ بِابْتِسامَةٍ حُلْوَةٍ وَكَلِمَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa-idhā ʿāda zawjuki min ʿamalihi mutʿaban, fa-staqbilīhi bi-btisāmatin ḥulwatin wa-kalimatin ṭayyiba
dialogue.en: When your husband comes back tired from work, welcome him with a sweet smile and a kind word.
dialogue.ur: Jab aapka shauhar thaka hua kaam se lautay to meethi muskurahat aur achhi baat se uska istiqbal karein.

dialogue.ar: فَالوَجْهُ المُشْرِقُ يُزيلُ تَعَبَ اليَوْمِ كُلِّهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-l-wajhu l-mushriqu yuzīlu taʿaba l-yawmi kullih
dialogue.en: A bright face removes the tiredness of the whole day.
dialogue.ur: Roshan chehra poore din ki thakan door kar deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلا تُحَوِّلي الأُمورَ التّافِهَةَ إِلى مَشاكِلَ كَبيرَةٍ، فَالحِوارُ الهادِئُ يَحُلُّ كَثيراً مِنْها.
dialogue.tr: wa-lā tuḥawwilī l-umūra t-tāfihata ilā mashākila kabīra, fa-l-ḥiwāru l-hādiʾu yaḥullu kathīran minhā
dialogue.en: Do not turn trivial things into big problems; calm talk solves many of them.
dialogue.ur: Chhoti chhoti baaton ko bade masaail mat banana; pur-sukoon guftagu bohat se masaail hal kar deti hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّنا نَسْمَعُ عَنْ حالاتِ طَلاقٍ كَثيرَةٍ سَبَبُها كَلِماتٌ قاسِيَةٌ وَقِلَّةُ صَبْرٍ.
dialogue.tr: innanā nasmaʿu ʿan ḥālāti ṭalāqin kathīratin sababuhā kalimātun qāsiyatun wa-qillatu ṣabr
dialogue.en: We hear of many divorce cases whose cause was harsh words and little patience.
dialogue.ur: Hum talaq ke bohat se waqiat sunte hain jin ki wajah sakht baatein aur sabr ki kami thi.

dialogue.ar: فَخُذي يا بُنَيَّتي العِبْرَةَ مِمَّنْ سَبَقوكِ، وَاصْبِري عَلى ما يَصْعُبُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-khudhī yā bunayyatī l-ʿibrata mimman sabaqūki, wa-ṣbirī ʿalā mā yaṣʿub
dialogue.en: So take a lesson, my little daughter, from those who came before you, and be patient with what is hard.
dialogue.ur: Pas bitiya, un se sabaq lo jo aapse pehle guzre, aur mushkil baaton par sabr karo.

dialogue.ar: وَلا تَنْشَغِلي بِالمَظاهِرِ مِنْ بَيْتٍ واسِعٍ وَثِيابٍ غالِيَةٍ وَهَدايا كَثيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa-lā tanshaghilī bi-l-maẓāhiri min baytin wāsiʿin wa-thiyābin ghāliyatin wa-hadāyā kathīra
dialogue.en: Do not be busy with appearances: a wide house, expensive clothes and many gifts.
dialogue.ur: Dikhawe mein mashghool na hona: bada ghar, mehnge kapde aur bohat se tohfe.

dialogue.ar: فَإِنَّ السَّعادَةَ تَنْبُعُ مِنْ قَلْبٍ طَيِّبٍ، وَتَفَهُّمٍ، وَتَقْديرٍ، وَمَوَدَّةٍ صادِقَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: fa-inna s-saʿādata tanbuʿu min qalbin ṭayyibin, wa-tafahhumin, wa-taqdīrin, wa-mawaddatin ṣādiqa
dialogue.en: Happiness springs from a kind heart, understanding, appreciation and sincere affection.
dialogue.ur: Khushi ek nek dil, samajhdari, qadr-dani aur sachi mohabbat se phootti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَسْأَلُ اللهَ أَنْ يُبارِكَ لَكِ، وَيَجْمَعَ بَيْنَكُما عَلى الخَيْرِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-asʾalu llāha an yubāraka laki, wa-yajmaʿa baynakumā ʿalā l-khayr
dialogue.en: I ask Allah to bless you and unite you both in goodness.
dialogue.ur: Main Allah se dua karta hoon ke woh aapko barakat de aur aap dono ko bhalai par jama rakhe.

q.en: What does the father say marriage is?
q.ur: Baap ke mutabiq shaadi kya hai?

q.en: What does the father advise when the husband comes home tired?
q.ur: Shauhar thaka hua ghar aaye to baap kya mashwara dete hain?
q.ar: بِماذا يَنْصَحُ الأَبُ حينَ يَعودُ الزَّوْجُ مُتْعَباً؟

options: Welcome him with a smile and a kind word

q.en: Which wrong idea does the father mention?
q.ur: Baap kaun si ghalat soch ka zikr karte hain?

options: That married life is only fun and games
options_ar: أَنَّ الحَياةَ الزَّوْجِيَّةَ لَهْوٌ وَتَسْلِيَةٌ فَقَطْ

q.en: According to the father, where does happiness come from?
q.ur: Baap ke mutabiq khushi kahan se aati hai?
q.ar: مِنْ أَيْنَ تَأْتي السَّعادَةُ بِحَسَبِ الأَبِ؟

options: A kind heart, understanding and sincere affection
options_ar: مِنْ قَلْبٍ طَيِّبٍ وَتَفَهُّمٍ وَمَوَدَّةٍ صادِقَةٍ

q.en: What does the word زَوْجَة mean?
q.ur: Lafz زَوْجَة ka kya matlab hai?

intro.en: Here you practise the father's text: put the ideas in order, answer questions, find opposites and fill in the blanks with إِنَّ (inna) and the phrase 'دَوْراً كَبيراً في' (a big role in). The answers are shown on the slides.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum matan ki mashq karte hain: khayalat ko tarteeb dena, sawalon ke jawab, ulte alfaaz dhoondna, aur إِنَّ aur 'دَوْراً كَبيراً في' (is mein bara kirdar) se khali jagah bharna. Jawab slides par maujood hain.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى نَصِّ الأَبِ: نُرَتِّبُ الأَفْكارَ، وَنُجيبُ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ، وَنَجِدُ الأَضْدادَ، وَنَمْلَأُ الفَراغاتِ بِـ «إِنَّ» وَبِعِبارَةِ «دَوْراً كَبيراً في». وَتَجِدُ الإِجاباتِ في الشَّرائِحِ.

q.en: What is the opposite of سَعيد (happy)?
What does دَمار mean?
Complete: إِنَّ التَّرْبِيَةَ ... كَبيراً في بِناءِ الأَجْيالِ. Which word fits?
q.ur: Mukammal karein: إِنَّ التَّرْبِيَةَ ... كَبيراً في بِناءِ الأَجْيالِ. Kaunsa lafz theek hai?
q.ar: أَكْمِلْ: إِنَّ التَّرْبِيَةَ ... كَبيراً في بِناءِ الأَجْيالِ. أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُناسِبُ؟

q.en: What does النَّشْء mean?

intro.en: The active participle names the person doing the action: from كَتَبَ (he wrote) we get كاتِب (writer). For simple three-letter verbs the pattern is فاعِل (e.g. سائِل 'asker', طارِق 'knocker'). For longer verbs it starts with مُ- (e.g. مُجاهِد 'one who strives', مُؤَذِّن 'caller to prayer').
intro.ur: Ism-ul-faail us shakhs ka naam hai jo kaam karta hai: كَتَبَ (usne likha) se كاتِب (likhne wala). Teen harfi aasaan fel se wazan فاعِل banta hai (jaise سائِل 'poochne wala'). Lambe fel se yeh مُ- se shuru hota hai (jaise مُجاهِد 'koshish karne wala', مُؤَذِّن 'azaan dene wala').
intro.ar: اسْمُ الفاعِلِ يَدُلُّ عَلى مَنْ يَقومُ بِالفِعْلِ: مِنْ «كَتَبَ» نَقولُ «كاتِب». وَيَأْتي مِنَ الثُّلاثِيِّ عَلى وَزْنِ «فاعِل» مِثْلِ سائِل وَطارِق، وَمِنْ غَيْرِ الثُّلاثِيِّ يَبْدَأُ بِمِيمٍ مَضْمومَةٍ مِثْلِ مُجاهِد وَمُؤَذِّن.

q.en: What is the active participle of كَتَبَ (he wrote)?
q.ur: كَتَبَ (usne likha) ka ism-ul-faail kya hai?

q.en: Which word means 'patient (one who is patient)'?
Which is an active participle of a longer verb (starts with مُ)?
q.ur: Kaunsa lambe fel ka ism-ul-faail hai (مُ se shuru)?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ فاعِلٍ مِنْ فِعْلٍ غَيْرِ ثُلاثِيٍّ (تَبْدَأُ بِمُ)؟

q.en: What does مُؤَذِّن mean?

title.en: Listening: a son who travels to study
title.ur: Sunna: beta jo parhne ke liye safar karta hai

intro.en: Listen to the two parts of the story about a son who travels abroad to study, and about students who live away from home. Then answer true/false questions, put events in order and choose the right answer. Listen to the audio on the slides.
intro.ur: Ek beta jo parhne ke liye pardes jata hai aur woh talba jo ghar se door rehte hain, is kahani ke do hisse sunein. Phir sahi/ghalat ke sawal, waqiat ki tarteeb aur sahi jawab chunein. Audio slides par hai.
intro.ar: نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى جُزْأَيْ قِصَّةِ ابْنٍ يُسافِرُ لِلدِّراسَةِ في الخارِجِ، وَطُلّابٍ يَعيشونَ بَعيداً عَنْ بُيوتِهِمْ. ثُمَّ نُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ، وَنُرَتِّبُ الأَحْداثَ، وَنَخْتارُ الإِجابَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ. نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى الصَّوْتِ في الشَّرائِحِ.

dialogue.ar: سافَرَ سَلْمانُ إِلى أُورُوبّا لِيَدْرُسَ الطِّبَّ.
dialogue.tr: sāfara salmānu ilā ūrūbbā li-yadrusa ṭ-ṭibb
dialogue.en: Salman travelled to Europe to study medicine.
dialogue.ur: Salman medicine parhne ke liye Europe gaya.

dialogue.ar: قالَ أَبوهُ: سَأُفَكِّرُ طَويلاً، فَالقَرارُ كَبيرٌ.
dialogue.tr: qāla abūhu: sa-ufakkiru ṭawīlan, fa-l-qarāru kabīr
dialogue.en: His father said: I will think for a long time, for the decision is big.
dialogue.ur: Uske abbu ne kaha: main der tak sochunga, kyunke faisla bara hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي النِّهايَةِ وافَقَ لِأَنَّ هَدَفَ ابْنِهِ نَبيلٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa-fī n-nihāyati wāfaqa li-anna hadafa ibnihi nabīl
dialogue.en: In the end he agreed because his son's goal was noble.
dialogue.ur: Aakhir mein woh maan gaye kyunke bete ka maqsad nek tha.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ أُمُّهُ حَزينَةً لِأَنَّهُ سَيَبْتَعِدُ عَنْها.
dialogue.tr: kānat ummuhu ḥazīnatan li-annahu sa-yabtaʿidu ʿanhā
dialogue.en: His mother was sad because he would be far from her.
dialogue.ur: Uski ammi udaas thin kyunke woh unse door jane wala tha.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعَتِ الأُمُّ لِعَقْلِها وَلَمْ تَتْرُكْ لِعاطِفَتِها القَرارَ.
dialogue.tr: samiʿati l-ummu li-ʿaqlihā wa-lam tatruk li-ʿāṭifatihā l-qarār
dialogue.en: The mother listened to her reason and did not leave the decision to her emotion.
dialogue.ur: Ammi ne apni aql ki suni aur faisla sirf jazbaat par nahin chhoda.

dialogue.ar: كَتَبَ سَلْمانُ رِسالَةً إِلى أُمِّهِ يُخْبِرُها فيها أَنَّهُ بِخَيْرٍ.
dialogue.tr: kataba salmānu risālatan ilā ummihi yukhbiruhā fīhā annahu bi-khayr
dialogue.en: Salman wrote a letter to his mother telling her that he was well.
dialogue.ur: Salman ne ammi ko khat likha jis mein bataya ke woh khairiyat se hai.

dialogue.ar: قَرَأَتِ الأُمُّ الرِّسالَةَ فَصارَتْ مَسْرورَةً.
dialogue.tr: qaraʾati l-ummu r-risālata fa-ṣārat masrūra
dialogue.en: The mother read the letter and became happy.
dialogue.ur: Ammi ne khat parha to khush ho gayin.

dialogue.ar: يَعيشُ الطُّلّابُ المُغْتَرِبونَ بَعيداً عَنْ بُيوتِهِمْ وَيَتَعَلَّمونَ ثَقافَةً جَديدَةً.
dialogue.tr: yaʿīshu ṭ-ṭullābu l-mughtaribūna baʿīdan ʿan buyūtihim wa-yataʿallamūna thaqāfatan jadīda
dialogue.en: Students living abroad live far from their homes and learn a new culture.
dialogue.ur: Pardes mein rehne wale talba ghar se door rehte hain aur nayi saqafat seekhte hain.

q.en: Why did the son travel?
What does الاغْتِراب mean?
What do students abroad learn?
q.ur: Pardes mein talba kya seekhte hain?

q.en: The father agreed because...

title.en: Speaking and writing: marriage and the returning son
title.ur: Guftagu aur likhna: shaadi aur wapas na aane wala beta

intro.en: Discuss with a partner whether you agree with statements about marriage and give a reason. Then explain the two hadiths, and write a story or an essay about a young man who studies abroad and comes back, using the hints. No new rules here, just speaking and writing practice.
intro.ur: Kisi saathi ke saath baat karein ke shaadi ke baare mein in jumlon se aap muttafiq hain ya nahin, aur wajah batayein. Phir do ahadees samjhayein, aur ishaaron ki madad se ek aise naujawan ki kahani ya mazmoon likhein jo pardes mein parhta hai aur wapas aata hai. Yahan naye qawaid nahin, sirf bolne aur likhne ki mashq hai.
intro.ar: نُناقِشُ مَعَ زَميلٍ عِباراتٍ عَنِ الزَّواجِ وَنَقولُ هَلْ نُوافِقُ عَلَيْها مَعَ ذِكْرِ السَّبَبِ. ثُمَّ نَشْرَحُ الحَديثَيْنِ، وَنَكْتُبُ قِصَّةً أَوْ مَقالَةً عَنْ شابٍّ يَدْرُسُ في الخارِجِ ثُمَّ يَعودُ، بِمُساعَدَةِ الإِشاراتِ. لا قَواعِدَ جَديدَةً هُنا، فَقَطْ تَدْريبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ وَالكِتابَةِ.

dialogue.ar: الزَّواجُ النّاجِحُ يَقومُ عَلى الاحْتِرامِ وَالصَّبْرِ.
dialogue.tr: az-zawāju n-nājiḥu yaqūmu ʿalā l-iḥtirāmi wa-ṣ-ṣabr
dialogue.en: A successful marriage is built on respect and patience.
dialogue.ur: Kamyab shaadi ehteram aur sabr par qaim hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: تَحُلُّ الأُسْرَةُ مُشْكِلاتِها بِالحِوارِ وَالتَّفاهُمِ.
dialogue.tr: taḥullu l-usratu mushkilātihā bi-l-ḥiwāri wa-t-tafāhum
dialogue.en: A family solves its problems through dialogue and understanding.
dialogue.ur: Khandan apne masaail guftagu aur ek doosre ko samajh kar hal karta hai.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَجْمَلِ ثِمارِ الزَّواجِ أَوْلادٌ يَدْعونَ لِوالِدَيْهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: min ajmali thimāri z-zawāji awlādun yadʿūna li-wālidayhim
dialogue.en: Among the loveliest fruits of marriage are children who pray for their parents.
dialogue.ur: Shaadi ke sab se khoobsurat phalon mein woh bachche hain jo walidain ke liye dua karte hain.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِهِ، وَأَنا خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلي». رَواهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ﷺ: khayrukum khayrukum li-ahlih, wa-anā khayrukum li-ahlī. rawāhu t-Tirmidhī
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: 'The best of you is the best to his family, and I am the best of you to my family.' Narrated by at-Tirmidhi.
dialogue.ur: Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Tum mein behtar woh hai jo apne ahl ke liye behtar ho, aur main apne ahl ke liye tum sab se behtar hoon.' Ise Tirmidhi ne riwayat kiya.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «اسْتَوْصُوا بِالنِّساءِ خَيْراً». رَواهُ البُخارِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ﷺ: istawṣū bin-nisāʾi khayran. rawāhu l-Bukhārī
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: 'Treat women well.' Narrated by al-Bukhari.
dialogue.ur: Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Auraton ke saath bhalai ki wasiyyat qubool karo.' Ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya.

dialogue.ar: شابٌّ يَدْرُسُ في جامِعَةٍ بَعيدَةٍ وَيَتَفَوَّقُ فيها.
dialogue.tr: shābbun yadrusu fī jāmiʿatin baʿīdatin wa-yatafawwaqu fīhā
dialogue.en: A young man studies at a distant university and excels there.
dialogue.ur: Ek naujawan door ki university mein parhta hai aur wahan aage nikalta hai.

dialogue.ar: يُرْسِلُ إِلى أَهْلِهِ رَسائِلَ، وَيَزورُهُمْ في العُطْلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yursilu ilā ahlihi rasāʾila, wa-yazūruhum fī l-ʿuṭla
dialogue.en: He sends letters to his family and visits them in the holiday.
dialogue.ur: Woh ghar walon ko khat bhejta hai aur chhuttiyon mein unse milne aata hai.

dialogue.ar: يَعودُ إِلى وَطَنِهِ وَيَبْني مَزْرَعَةً تَنْفَعُ بَلَدَهُ وَتُسْعِدُ والِدَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: yaʿūdu ilā waṭanihi wa-yabnī mazraʿatan tanfaʿu baladahu wa-tusʿidu wālidayh
dialogue.en: He returns to his homeland and builds a farm that benefits his country and makes his parents happy.
dialogue.ur: Woh apne watan wapas aata hai aur aisa farm banata hai jo mulk ko faida deta hai aur walidain ko khush karta hai.

q.en: According to the hadith in the book, who is the best of people?
q.ur: Kitaab ki hadees ke mutabiq behtar kaun hai?
q.ar: بِحَسَبِ الحَديثِ في الكِتابِ، مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرُ النّاسِ؟

q.en: What does الحِوار mean?
What does اسْتَوْصُوا بِالنِّساءِ خَيْراً ask us to do?
q.ur: اسْتَوْصُوا بِالنِّساءِ خَيْراً hum se kya kehta hai?

q.en: What does وَطَن mean?

title.en: Grammar: the passive participle and spelling

intro.en: The passive participle names the one who receives the action: from حُفِظَ (it was kept) we get مَحْفوظ (kept, preserved). For simple verbs the pattern is مَفْعول (مَكْتوب 'written'); for longer verbs it starts with مُ- (مُكَرَّم 'honoured'). Then we practise spelling: the connecting hamza (همزة وصل), extra or dropped alif and wāw.
intro.ur: Ism-ul-mafool us cheez ka naam hai jis par kaam hota hai: حُفِظَ (mehfooz kiya gaya) se مَحْفوظ (mehfooz). Aasaan fel se wazan مَفْعول banta hai (مَكْتوب 'likha hua'); lambe fel se yeh مُ- se shuru hota hai (مُكَرَّم 'izzat diya gaya'). Phir imla ki mashq: hamzat-ul-wasl, alif aur waw ka izafa ya hazf.
intro.ar: اسْمُ المَفْعولِ يَدُلُّ عَلى مَنْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ: مِنْ «حُفِظَ» نَقولُ «مَحْفوظ». وَيَأْتي مِنَ الثُّلاثِيِّ عَلى وَزْنِ «مَفْعول» مِثْلِ مَكْتوب، وَمِنْ غَيْرِ الثُّلاثِيِّ يَبْدَأُ بِمِيمٍ مَضْمومَةٍ مِثْلِ مُكَرَّم. ثُمَّ نَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الإِمْلاءِ: هَمْزَةِ الوَصْلِ، وَزيادَةِ الأَلِفِ أَوِ الواوِ وَحَذْفِهِما.

q.en: What is the passive participle of عَرَفَ / عُرِفَ (known)?
q.ur: عُرِفَ (jaana gaya) ka ism-ul-mafool kya hai?

q.en: What does مَحْفوظ mean?
Which one is a passive participle?
What does مُغْلَقَة mean?

intro.en: A review of the unit: meanings of verbs, finding the active participle (فاعِل / مُفْعِل) and the passive participle (مَفْعول / مُفْعَل), and using them in sentences. Check your answers on the slides.
intro.ur: Is unit ki dohrai: fel ke maani, ism-ul-faail (فاعِل / مُفْعِل) aur ism-ul-mafool (مَفْعول / مُفْعَل) pehchanna, aur unhein jumlon mein istemal karna. Apne jawab slides par dekhein.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلوَحْدَةِ: مَعاني الأَفْعالِ، وَإيجادُ اسْمِ الفاعِلِ (فاعِل / مُفْعِل) وَاسْمِ المَفْعولِ (مَفْعول / مُفْعَل)، وَاسْتِعْمالُهُما في جُمَلٍ. تَحَقَّقْ مِنْ إِجاباتِكَ في الشَّرائِحِ.

q.en: Which word is an active participle (the doer)?
q.ur: Kaunsa lafz ism-ul-faail hai (kaam karne wala)?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ فاعِلٍ، أَيْ مَنْ يَقومُ بِالفِعْلِ؟

q.en: Which word is a passive participle (receives the action)?
q.ur: Kaunsa lafz ism-ul-mafool hai (jis par kaam ho)?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ مَفْعولٍ، أَيْ مَنْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ؟

q.en: What does مَسْؤول mean?
What does أَوْصَدَ mean?
